status_authority: Local execution report; this specification does not record project completion.

tokenizer.metric_scope: UTF-8 rendered_context only; no JSON envelope, tool framing, conversation or model billing
tokenizer.legacy_field: token_estimate is an exact native encoding count, not a heuristic; report its equality to the independent Python count
tokenizer.baseline: Read each canonical .md or .yaml authority file once, sorted by relative path, and join their complete UTF-8 contents with one LF. Exclude manifest/configuration/runtime files. Never concatenate raw and canonical copies of the same facts.

controlled_dependency_probe.selection: First sorted existing direct prerequisite; retain every other source fact
controlled_dependency_probe.blocker: The prerequisite supporting receipt is awaiting review.
controlled_dependency_probe.next_action: Review the prerequisite receipt before the dependent work proceeds.
controlled_dependency_probe.meaning: An isolated coverage probe, not a change to the historical project status or real business acceptance.

aggregation: Use the maximum L0 and L1 counts, minimum compression ratio and all exact fact assertions across every baseline repetition and the controlled probe. All gates must pass; never average away a missing hard fact or select a favorable project ID.
boundary: Fresh native CLI processes, no model calls, and a new disposable project per case. This proves deterministic source-to-context retrieval for the frozen sample. It does not measure model recall, automatic hooks, E4 or release readiness. Publish aggregate counts and hashes; retain private facts, source paths and raw CLI receipts locally.
